# cxstatusline

> A customizable, low-overhead statusline and widget system for OpenAI Codex CLI. Renders real-time telemetry (model info, Git branch and diff, context token tracking, 5-hour and weekly rate limits, session timers, and custom commands) directly in your terminal footer with Powerline themes and an interactive TUI configurator.

## Main sections

- [Online Playground & Configurator](https://cxstatusline.adrijshikhar.dev): Live browser-based terminal preview to arrange widgets, choose themes, and export configuration JSON.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/adrijshikhar/cxstatusline): Source code, release binaries, issue tracker, discussions, and developer documentation.
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cxstatusline): Official package registry distribution for `npx -y cxstatusline@latest` or `bunx -y cxstatusline@latest`.
- [Widget Catalog](https://github.com/adrijshikhar/cxstatusline#widgets): Full list of 36 widgets including model, thinking effort, Git status, context usage, and custom shell commands.
- [Compatibility Matrix](https://github.com/adrijshikhar/cxstatusline#requirements): Support matrix and prebuilt binaries for official OpenAI Codex CLI releases on macOS and Linux.

## Key facts

- **Purpose**: Replaces the default fixed Codex CLI footer with a fully customizable, multi-row statusline.
- **Widgets**: 36 built-in widgets across 1 to 3 rows, including model name, thinking effort, Git branch, Git diff (+/-), context token count, 5-hour usage percentage, 5-hour reset timer, weekly usage percentage, weekly reset timer, session duration, token speeds, memory, and custom shell commands.
- **ccstatusline Interoperability**: Preset syntax and widget IDs match `ccstatusline` (the Claude Code statusline tool), enabling effortless transition and configuration import between Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI.
- **Performance**: Zero noticeable latency on prompt redraws via cached local telemetry files (`~/.config/cxstatusline/settings.json`) and compiled prebuilt patch binaries.
- **Platform Support**: Verified on macOS (Apple Silicon darwin-arm64, Intel darwin-x64) and Linux (linux-x64, linux-arm64).
- **Engine & Runtime**: Built with TypeScript and Node.js >= 22 / Bun >= 1.4; runtime supports Node.js >= 18 and Bun >= 1.2.
- **License**: MIT open source.
